## What it is

jsonxmleditor.com: free online developer and data tools. JSON and XML formatting, validation and conversion, data tools (CSV/Excel viewer, SQL on CSV, pivot tables, charts, cleaner, compare), generators and the Claude Code SDLC generator. Most tools run in the browser; the Spring Boot back end serves the pages and a few conversion and generator APIs.
